title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Conviction

achievements.reason: No Steam list: Steam app 33220 ("Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Conviction™") returns an empty achievement schema, and the global percentages call returned HTTP 500 twice. RAWG lists 54 achievements (with RAWG's own percentages): finishing each of the 11 single-player missions and the 4 co-op story missions, two story choices about Tom Reed and one about Anna Grimsdottir, Realistic runs of both stories, the Hunter, Last Stand, Face-Off and Infiltration modes, co-op maps named after US cities, the Vanish, Prepare & Execute and Splinter Cell challenge groups, and weapon, gadget and uniform purchases. These could seed an original checklist.

Chapters use the single-player and co-op mission names on StrategyWiki's contents page, in its order, plus chapters for the modes and goals RAWG's achievement list names.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 19568). Steam app 33220 is the only store-list match, but it returned no achievements (see the collectible note), so steam=None and the chapters come from StrategyWiki page names (swNames). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Conviction" at completion stage 1. Written subpages: Achievements (about 7,700 characters), Uplay (about 2,600), P.E.C. Challenges (about 2,600), Table of Contents (about 2,000), Weapons and Gadgets (about 1,300) and Controls (about 900); Gameplay, Walkthrough, Uniforms and all 15 mission pages are linked but not written, so it was not used as a walkthrough. The chapters use its mission names in contents order: 11 single-player missions from "Merchant's Street Market" to "White House", then 4 co-op missions from "St Petersburg Banya" to "Modzok Proving Grounds"; RAWG's achievements name the same 15 missions and call the last four "CO-OP Story" missions (RAWG writes "St. Petersburg Banya" with a full stop). The split of the single-player missions into two groups is our own choice, and the summaries are placeholders. RAWG's list also names co-op maps ("San Francisco, CA", "Salt Lake City, UT", "Portland, ME", "New Orleans, LA", "Washroom", "Crypt", "Under Construction") and "Deniable Ops: Insurgency"; they are not on the StrategyWiki contents page and are only mentioned in the Deniable Ops chapter. splintercell.fandom.com answers the API under "Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Conviction" with about 200 linked articles (including "Deniable Ops", "Hunter", "Last Stand", "Face-Off", "Infiltration" and mission names); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
